title: Ash Blast/Skill history

{{skill history}}

==[[Feedback:Game updates/20120913|September 13, 2012]] ==
*Changed type to hex spell; increased recharge to 15 seconds; changed functionality to: "Target and adjacent foes are struck for 35...65 earth damage. Burning foes struck by Ash Blast are hexed for 5 seconds and have a 20...75% chance to miss with attacks."
